description: This file defines the LoginPage component for a React-based frontend, responsible for rendering a login form that authenticates users via Supabase and handles navigation based on authentication status and URL parameters.

methods.name: safeReturnTo
methods.description: Ensures the return path is within the app to prevent open redirects.
